rubric_hint.rule: 2 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Notified regeneration felling, 4.5 ha polygon, status notified; no completed felling overlap (0%).
No species records within 250 m, and no records inside the polygon or within 250 m (near-site effort 0 records).

Two eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m: Bryoria bicolor (EN, lichen, 3 records, nearest 435 m, 2024, 10 m uncertainty) and Alectoria sarmentosa (VU, lichen, nearest 491 m, 2024). Both site-bound, forest-associated, with felling-relevant threats such as lack of continuity forest.

Four site-bound forest NT species also recorded 435-463 m away (e.g. Hypogymnia vittata, Bryoria nadvornikiana, Crustoderma corneum, Cystostereum murrayi); all beyond 250 m so they do not trigger the NT rule.

Effort around the site is adequate (193 records, 59 species, 88th percentile vs county median 27), so the lack of near-site records is somewhat more informative than at a thinly surveyed site, though still not proof of absence.

uncertainties: Records lie 435-491 m away; whether similar habitat extends into the polygon is not shown.
Near-site recording was zero within 250 m, so absence there may reflect no visits rather than no species.
not_established: Presence or absence of the species on the notified polygon
Forest condition or biodiversity of the site
next_action: Reviewer should check whether the 2024 lichen record cluster ~435-490 m away is in the same stand or connected habitat and consider a field survey of the polygon edge toward it.
